CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

September 10, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: August 27, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the August 27, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  1
 D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  1301 West Valley Boulevard, DRB-2024-00007

  •  Request: This is an application for eleven (11) new signs that include channel
  letters, logos, clearance hanging sign, directional signage, and monument signs
  for a car wash business known as ‘Mister Car Wash’.
  •  Applicant: Miriam Hansen
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  Conditions of Approval:
  1. The applicant shall add an illustration / image of the proposed canopy design
  on the plan set.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  1001 South Garfield Avenue, DRB-2024-00089

  •  Request: This is an application repaint the existing stucco walls of an existing 2-
  story commercial building.
  •  Applicant: Lynn Tran
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS- The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions of approval:
  1. The base of the monument sign and any other exterior stucco walls on the
  property must be painted to match the proposed color of the building.
  2. The exposed roof rafters shall have a natural material appearance, such as a
  natural wood stain / finish.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The base of the monument sign and any other exterior stucco walls on the
  property must be painted to match the proposed color of the building.

  2
   2. The exposed roof rafters and eaves shall have a natural material appearance,
  such as a natural wood stain or paint color that is complementary to the stucco
  color.
  3. The applicant shall submit the proposed wood stain or paint color for the City
  Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 4:  1521 South Monterey Street, DRB-2024-00062

  •  Request: This is an application for a new front patio and exterior remodel of an
  existing 1212 SF 1-story single-family residence.
  •  Applicant: James Fenske
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions of approval:
  1. Window Type #1, as shown in the window schedule, shall have at least one (1)
  horizontal permanently applied grid / muntin to match the existing window
  appearance.
  2. Update window schedule and elevations accordingly in response to Condition
  #1.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Window Type #1, as shown in the window schedule, shall have at least one (1)
  horizontal permanently applied grid / muntin to match the existing window
  appearance.
  2. Update window schedule and elevations accordingly in response to Condition
  #1.
  3. Update door schedule or elevations to identify the proposed door color/finish.
  4. Update East Elevation to accurately show the porch roof line height/level.
  5. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  3
 ITEM 5:  19 South Garfield Avenue, DRB-2024-00093

  •  Request: This is an application for a Uniform Sign Program for a 2-story
  commercial building with six (6) tenants total fronting South Garfield Avenue.
  •  Applicant: John Estrada
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions of approval:
  1. Revise the sign program to allow a maximum of one primary wall sign for each
  business, rather than each tenant space.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  Conditions of Approval:
  1. Window Revise the sign program to allow a maximum of one primary wall sign
  for each business, rather than each tenant space.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 6:  3161 Midvale Place, DRB-2024-00044

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 1,148 SF 1- and 2-story addition to an
  existing 600 SF 1-story single-family residence, a new front porch, and new
  detached 2-car garage located at the rear of the property.
  •  Applicant: Kenneth Rojas
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  Conditions of Approval:
  1. The project shall provide screening, such as planting or fencing, to cover the
  proposed A/C unit and equipment from the public right-of-way.
  2. The project shall provide window trimming / casing around the window to
  properly transition the siding to window openings.
  3. The project shall provide a wood trim at the base of the overhang to properly
  transition from wall plane to ceiling.
  4. The applicant shall identify / callout the proposed garage door and wall
  cladding materials.

  4
   5. The front porch post should move towards the east to be in-line with the
  existing wall much as possible while complying with Planning code.
  6. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:05 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on September 24, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:05 P.M.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez, Ng
